I just had a thought...

The members of the Vengeance Five are all a bit, well, shit... At least as far as villains go. It's clear that they are all second rate, B-quality villains at best, and so need the team. Well, what if the heroes in Vengeance are similar? A team of heroes that are really not that heroic, but still somehow get the job done?

I'm thinking of inspiration taken from the movie Mystery Men, about inept superheroes. That movie featured Mr Furious, who's power was "getting angry", without actually giving him any super strength. It also had The Shoveller, who... Hit people with a shovel. Invisible Boy, who couldn't actually become invisible, he just thought that he could, so he took his clothes off all the time. The Blue Raja - he, well, threw forks. The only real super was The Bowler, who had a magical bowling ball with her father's skull in it.

Maybe these guys wouldn't make decent playable heroes, but as some sort of sidekick card? That would be sweet.
